english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for being socially shy or reserved, especially around unfamiliar people.
Use this when the person's withdrawn behavior is specifically due to shyness or embarrassment.
Use this when the timidity is mainly shyness or self-consciousness around other people.
Use this when the self-consciousness specifically feels like shyness or embarrassment in front of other people.

examples.english: I get shy whenever I see strangers.
examples.traditional: 我見到陌生人就好怕醜。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 mak6 saang1 jan4 zau6 hou2 paa3 cau2

examples.english: My little sister is withdrawn and hides behind me when she sees strangers.
examples.traditional: 我個妹好怕醜，見到生人就匿喺我後面。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 go3 mui6 hou2 paa3 cau2 gin3 dou2 saang1 jan4 zau6 nei1 hai2 ngo5 hau6 min6

examples.english: They are so timid that they blush even when asked to sing a song on stage.
examples.traditional: 佢咁怕醜，叫佢上台唱首歌都面紅。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 paa3 cau2 giu3 keoi5 soeng5 toi1 coeng3 sau2 go1 dou1 min6 hung4

examples.english: The child felt self-conscious and hid behind me.
examples.traditional: 小朋友第一次見到咁多人，怕醜到匿喺我身後。
examples.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 dou2 gam3 do1 jan4 paa3 cau2 dou2 nik1 hai2 ngo5 san1 hau6
